text: Biochemistry and molecular biology are interdisciplinary fields that combine biochemistry (the study of chemical substances and metabolic processes in living organisms) and molecular biology (the study of the structure, function and gene expression regulation of biological macromolecules). The core of it is to reveal the essence of life phenomena at the molecular level, such as the structure and function of biological macromolecules like proteins and nucleic acids, cell signal transduction, gene replication and expression, and the molecular mechanisms of disease occurrence. This discipline is the foundation of medicine, pharmacy, biotechnology and other majors, and also the core field of modern life science research.
